description: Update project name/description/status/dates. Changing key renames every issue identifier (WEB-12 -> NEW-12).

budget.description: the agreed budget (change it whenever the work grows); null clears it, then the total of the tasks is the budget

budget_currency.description: currency of the budget: UAH, USD, EUR...

budget_field.description: the NAME of the number / money / formula field whose total is the cost of the tasks

client.description: client name or id; "" or null removes the client

icon.description: an emoji shown instead of the first letter of the key; "" or null goes back to the letter

key.description: new short project key in capitals, e.g. "SHOP"; renames every issue identifier (WEB-12 -> SHOP-12)

parent.description: move it under another project (key or id) as a sub-project; "" or null = back to the top level

status.description: planned, active, paused, completed or canceled

name: update_project
